goal: Score how dangerous the current round is, from the wave number and how many survivors are alive, so the spawner and the music system read one number instead of each inventing their own escalation.
acceptance_criteria: A ModuleScript at src/shared/ThreatLevel.luau returns a table of pure annotated functions and touches no Roblox service.
An exported type names the bands the score falls into, as a union of string literals.
The score rises with the wave number and falls as survivors are lost, and both directions are stated in a comment.
A wave below one or a survivor count below zero is clamped rather than producing a negative score.
Every file begins with --!strict and the whole project passes scripts/verify.ps1.
notes: Keep it small: one module, under 120 lines. A short answer is a correct answer more often.
Return only the files you create. Do not return a file you are not changing.
